solutions.title: All subarray sums
solutions.strategy: Start at every index and extend right while tracking the running sum.

timeComplexity.explanation: There are quadratically many start/end pairs.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only running and best sums are stored.

solutions.title: Kadane running best
solutions.strategy: At each index, keep the best subarray ending at that index and the global best.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each value contributes one constant-time transition.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The dynamic state compresses to two scalar sums.
